title: Approval links reach agents whose client declines them
items: The hosted MCP server answers a declined or closed approval or checkout request with the link, the code and what is asked, so the agent can show them, and a wait that ends unanswered repeats them
Tools that take an endpoint's slug take it as slug or endpointSlug, and describe reports the MCP server's version beside the SDK's

The MCP docs state the current tool counts (104 local, 101 hosted) and give change_plan, set_seats, change_addons, cancel_subscription, resume_subscription, get_agent_budget and set_agent_budget sections of their own
